capability: Deterministic solvent-polymer compatibility classification via Hansen Solubility Parameters (HSP) with polymer-specific interaction radius (Hansen sphere test)
population: Defined single-component solvents with published HSP (δD, δP, δH) and linear/uncured polymers with published Hansen sphere parameters (δD, δP, δH, R). Applicability domain excludes commercial polydisperse grades, mixture solvents, and cross-linked/cured networks.
split_methodology: Per-polymer generalization: each polymer's Ra ≤ R sphere is evaluated independently against its published R; no cross-polymer calibration is performed. Compatibility labels come from independent published solvency literature (Van Krevelen 4th ed. Table 7.5, Brandrup Polymer Handbook 4th ed. Section VII/571, Hansen 2nd ed. Fig 5.1, supplier TDS solvency charts), NOT computed from HSP distance.
theory: Hansen (1967) three-parameter distance in dispersion (δD), polar (δP), and hydrogen-bonding (δH) MPa^0.5 space. Ra² = 4(δD_s − δD_p)² + (δP_s − δP_p)² + (δH_s − δH_p)². RED = Ra / R. Compatible iff RED < 1.0. Fifty-plus years of industrial validation for solvent screening across paints, coatings, adhesives, and pharmaceutical formulation.

metrics.name: hsp_over_dd_baseline_lift
metrics.note: Baseline is single-parameter δD-proximity |δD_s − δD_p| < 3.0. Full Hansen 3-parameter distance improves classification by +44 percentage points.

metrics.name: high_confidence_false_compatible_rate
metrics.note: Safety-critical false-positive gate. Of pairs with RED ≤ 0.5 (high confidence), fraction predicted compatible but published incompatible.

metrics.name: applicability_domain_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: hansen_red returns None for all 6 probe attacks: NaN δD, Infinity δP, negative δD, zero R, negative R, negative polymer δD.

metrics.name: authority_lock_preservation_rate
metrics.note: Fixture authority block preserves optimizer_authority=false, constraint_only=true, commercial_product_authority=false.

metrics.name: auroc_hansen
metrics.note: Reported observationally at Phase-0. Phase-1 lock at config/benchmark-locks/amphora-solvency-score.v1.json will gate at AUROC ≥ 0.80 with a group-time-source-safe locked benchmark.

metrics.name: brier_score
metrics.note: Reported observationally at Phase-0. Confidence is smooth 1/(1+RED); calibration will be refined at Phase-1 with an isotonic post-hoc calibrator or a fitted logistic on Ra.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.solvent_parameters_source: Hansen 2nd ed. Table A.1 (15 solvents spanning aliphatic hydrocarbon, aromatic, chlorinated, ester, ketone, alcohol, ether, amide, protic-polar subgroups)
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: compatible iff Ra / R < 1.0, where Ra^2 = 4(dD_s - dD_p)^2 + (dP_s - dP_p)^2 + (dH_s - dH_p)^2
